author: LoG2 Co-op
description: A short adventure of its own: THE MISSING KEY CAPSULE. Shows the STORY tab (title, slots, intro, credits) and the story steps: a cutscene with camera, walking and emotes, faces in the text box, a companion, numbers (3 clues) and a timer, a dark park (MOOD), a boss fight with a second phase, a locked door that needs an item, a crate you break with an attack, saving and THE END. Choose it on the main menu (PLAY THE STORY).
name: Example - A Story Of Your Own (STORY MODE)
